rachel.chen: Morning! First-week setup question. My MacBook Air (M2) asset RWI-1307 hit 'Profile install failed (scep_error)' during enrollment and FileVault didn't kick in. I'm on Redwood VPN at home — could that cause it?
it-support: Hi Rachel, welcome! Yes, corporate VPN during Setup Assistant can block SCEP callbacks to our CA. If you can, disconnect VPN and retry enrollment while on a normal network (home wifi or phone hotspot). Can you paste output of `sudo profiles status -type enrollment`?
rachel.chen: shows `profiles: No enrolled profile found`. I was on VPN because I needed access to internal CI to fetch dotfiles.
it-support: That explains it. Two options: 1) sit on a non-VPN network and re-run enrollment, or 2) we can temporarily open SCEP endpoints for your current IP and reissue a short-lived token. Which do you prefer?
vpn-team: We can whitelist Rachel's public IP for 30 minutes if she needs to stay connected. Ping us "whitelist please" and include your IP (from whatsmyip.org).
rachel.chen: I'll just switch to hotspot, easier. Rebooting into setup now.
(5 minutes)
rachel.chen: Back — hotspot worked, got "Corporate device enrollment requested" banner, clicked Accept and completed Okta SSO. `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` -> `Enrolled via MDM (mdm.redwood.internal)`.
it-support: Great. Pushed FileVault enable policy — you'll get a modal to enable and escrow the recovery key. Recommend KMS escrow.
rachel.chen: Modal appeared, chose KMS escrow. `sudo fdesetup status` -> `FileVault is On`. One more Q: my company VPN profile was pushed after enrollment and it set split-tunnel rules that break gcloud auth. Any tips?
vpn-team: We'll adjust the split-tunnel route for dev ranges. Please open a ticket with example destination IPs and we'll apply a tweak to the policy for your user.
mdm-bot: Notice: Profile install and FileVault escrow completed for asset RWI-1307 at 2026-09-01T08:41:02Z.
rachel.chen: Thanks all, able to install Homebrew and VS Code now. Closing thread.
